description: This Java class defines a 'RabbitMQTarget', which encapsulates the exchange and optional routing key for messaging with RabbitMQ. It includes methods for creating instances from explicit parameters or from a target address string, parsing the necessary components.

classes.name: RabbitMQTarget
classes.description: An immutable class representing a RabbitMQ messaging target with exchange and optional routing key.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a RabbitMQTarget with the provided exchange and routing key.

methods.name: fromTargetAddress
methods.description: Creates a RabbitMQTarget instance by parsing a target address string of the format 'exchange/routingKey'. Throws ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException if the format is invalid.

methods.name: getExchangeFromTarget
methods.description: Private helper method that extracts the exchange part from a target address string.

methods.name: getRoutingKeyFromTarget
methods.description: Private helper method that extracts the routing key from a target address string.

methods.name: getRoutingKey
methods.description: Returns the routing key, or null if not set.
